raw_source.text: Zones contain a lower, main section, used for resizing and moving the zone itself, and a narrow upper section that defines fade ranges. Resizing of either section is done by clicking and dragging on its right or left edges, while moving is accomplished by clicking and dragging a zone from anywhere except its edges.

qualification: Both sections can be resized at their respective edges; the source move target is the zone itself. Prior shorthand is not evidence of independently translating the fade-range section by an interior drag. R3 selects the supported lower-main whole-zone move; independent fade-section translation remains U. This does not assert runtime absence or a source contradiction.
